rows.text: returns without writing when `rcx` is null, when qword `rcx+0xC0` is null, or when that record's dword `+0` is -1; otherwise clears bit 7 of the record's byte `+0x11` (AND `0x7f`) and ORs in `dl` shifted left by 7 (bit 0 of `dl` into bit 7)

returns when `cx` is -1; otherwise forms the record address qword `022C6F28` + sign-extended `cx` times 0x740 and, when that address is non-zero and the record's dword `+0x284` is non-zero, makes the call at `002EDB80` + 0x2F with the record and ORs 0x800 into its dword `+0x290`; on the other paths it returns without writing

notes: 002EDB80: the zero test on the record address is the je after the add at 002EDB9A (ZF of the sum).
